items.en: Don't give up the day job
items.example: Nice singing, mate. Don't give up the day job.
items.exampleTr: Güzel söyledin dostum. Sakın asıl işini bırakma.
items.simple: A joke: you are not good at this, so keep your real job.
dialogue: A: Did you like my stand-up routine?
B: Don't give up the day job.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; Amerikanca 'Don't quit your day job'.

items.en: Who died and made you boss
items.tr: kim seni patron yaptı, sen kimsin de emir veriyorsun
items.example: Who died and made you boss? I'll do it when I'm ready.
items.exampleTr: Seni kim patron yaptı? Hazır olunca yaparım.
items.simple: You say it when someone gives orders but is not in charge.
dialogue: A: Right, everyone, phones away and start cleaning.
B: Who died and made you boss?
items.note: Arkadaşlar arası; şaka ya da gerçek sitem olabilir.

items.example: Steady on, it was only a joke!
items.exampleTr: Yavaş ol, sadece bir şakaydı!
items.simple: Calm down, you are going too far.
dialogue: A: That's it, I'm selling your guitar!
B: Whoa, steady on!
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi, biraz eski moda ve şakacı.

items.example: "I've booked a table at the Ritz." "Ooh, get you!"
items.exampleTr: "Ritz'de masa ayırttım." "Vay, şuna bak hele!"
items.simple: A teasing way to say: look how fancy you are.
dialogue: A: I'm flying business class to Rome.
B: Ooh, get you!
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; caka satan arkadaşa takılmak için.

items.example: Someone's in a good mood. Did you win the lottery?
items.exampleTr: Birinin keyfi yerinde bakıyorum. Piyango mu vurdu?
items.simple: You tease a person who is very happy for no clear reason.
dialogue: A: Morning, everyone! Lovely day, isn't it?
B: Well, someone's in a good mood.
items.note: 'Someone' ile karşındakini kastedip takılırsın; tersi 'in a mood'.

items.en: I'll take that as a compliment
items.example: "You're so weird." "I'll take that as a compliment."
items.exampleTr: "Çok tuhafsın." "İltifat olarak kabul ediyorum."
items.simple: Someone says a rude thing, but you pretend it was nice.
dialogue: A: You dress like my grandad.
B: I'll take that as a compliment. He's very stylish.
items.note: Laf sokmayı tatlı bir cevapla savuşturmak.

items.example: "The whole family's coming to taste your cooking." "No pressure, then."
items.exampleTr: "Bütün aile yemeğini tatmaya geliyor." "Hiç baskı yok yani."
items.simple: A joke: there is a lot of pressure on me now.
dialogue: A: The CEO will be watching your presentation.
B: No pressure, then.
items.note: Büyük beklenti karşısında kuru espri.

items.example: "You should eat healthier." "Says the guy who had pizza for breakfast."
items.exampleTr: "Daha sağlıklı beslenmelisin." "Bunu kahvaltıda pizza yiyen adam mı söylüyor?"
items.simple: You point out the person does the same bad thing.
dialogue: A: You're always late.
B: Says the guy who missed his own birthday party.
items.note: Kadın için 'Says the woman who...', genel 'Says the person who...'.

items.example: Everyone left the room when I arrived. Was it something I said?
items.exampleTr: Ben gelince herkes odadan çıktı. Yanlış bir şey mi söyledim?
items.simple: A joke when people leave or go quiet around you.
dialogue: A: Right, I'm off. Bye!
B: Already? Was it something I said?
items.note: Genelde soru işaretiyle ve şaka yollu söylenir.

items.en: Thanks for the vote of confidence
items.example: "I bet you'll get lost." "Thanks for the vote of confidence."
items.exampleTr: "Bahse girerim kaybolursun." "Bana güvenin için sağ ol."
items.simple: You say thanks, but you mean: you don't believe in me.
dialogue: A: Are you sure you can cook for ten people?
B: Wow, thanks for the vote of confidence.
items.note: Biri sana güvenmediğini belli edince alaycı cevap.

items.example: "We're all too old for clubbing." "Speak for yourself!"
items.exampleTr: "Hepimiz kulüplere gitmek için çok yaşlıyız." "Sen kendi adına konuş!"
items.simple: That is true for you, not for me.
dialogue: A: We all look terrible in the morning.
B: Speak for yourself!
items.note: Genelleme yapan birine şakayla itiraz.

items.example: Well, this is awkward. We're wearing the same dress.
items.exampleTr: Eh, bu biraz garip oldu. Aynı elbiseyi giymişiz.
items.simple: You say it out loud when a moment feels uncomfortable.
dialogue: A: Oh. Hi. I didn't know your ex was coming tonight.
B: Well, this is awkward.
items.note: Garip anı itiraf ederek gerginliği yumuşatmak.

items.example: You've cleaned the whole flat? Not that I'm complaining.
items.exampleTr: Bütün evi mi temizledin? Şikayet ettiğimden değil.
items.simple: You are surprised, but you are happy about it.
dialogue: A: I've made you dinner and ironed your shirts.
B: What's going on? Not that I'm complaining.
items.note: Beklenmedik iyi bir şeyi şaşkınlıkla karşılarken.

items.en: I'm not just a pretty face
items.tr: ben sadece güzel bir surat değilim
items.example: I fixed the boiler myself. I'm not just a pretty face, you know.
items.exampleTr: Kombiyi kendim tamir ettim. Sadece güzel bir surat değilim yani.
items.simple: A funny way to say: I'm smart or useful too.
dialogue: A: You fixed the Wi-Fi? Impressive.
B: Well, I'm not just a pretty face.
items.note: Kendini övmeyi espriyle yapmak.

items.tr: hep böyle olur zaten, benim hayatım bu
items.example: The bus left just as I got there. Story of my life.
items.exampleTr: Ben gelince otobüs kalktı. Hep böyle olur zaten.
items.simple: Bad luck like this always happens to me.
dialogue: A: Sorry, we just sold the last piece of cake.
B: Story of my life.
items.note: Kendini tiye alan, şikayetçi espri.

items.example: "How did you burn water?" "It's a gift."
items.exampleTr: "Suyu nasıl yaktın?" "Allah vergisi."
items.simple: A joke when you are amazingly bad, or good, at something.
dialogue: A: You've broken three mugs this week!
B: What can I say? It's a gift.
items.note: Kendi beceriksizliğine kuru espri.

items.example: "Who wants to help me move the piano?" Silence. "Don't all rush at once."
items.exampleTr: "Piyanoyu taşımama kim yardım eder?" Sessizlik. "Hep birden koşuşmayın."
items.simple: A joke when nobody wants to help.
dialogue: A: Right, who's going to help me clean the fridge?
B: Er...
A: Don't all rush at once.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; gönüllü çıkmayınca.

items.example: Remind me never to play cards with you again.
items.exampleTr: Hatırlat da seninle bir daha asla kart oynamayayım.
items.simple: A joke: you are so good, or bad, I won't do this again.
dialogue: A: I won every game tonight.
B: Remind me never to play Monopoly with you.
items.note: Arkadaşın çok iyi ya da çok kötü bir şey yapınca.

items.example: "Dad's tidied his desk." "Hold the front page!"
items.exampleTr: "Babam masasını toplamış." "Durdurun baskıyı!"
items.simple: A joke when news is not exciting at all.
dialogue: A: I went to the gym today.
B: Hold the front page!
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; Amerikanca karşılığı 'Stop the presses'.

items.example: You made your bed? Alert the media.
items.exampleTr: Yatağını mı topladın? Basını çağıralım.
items.simple: A joke when someone acts proud of something small.
dialogue: A: I replied to all my emails today.
B: Alert the media!
items.note: Küçük bir başarıyı abartan birine takılmak.

items.en: Tell us what you really think
items.example: "That's the ugliest sofa I've ever seen." "Tell us what you really think."
items.exampleTr: "Gördüğüm en çirkin kanepe." "İçinden geçeni söyle bari."
items.simple: A joke when someone is very, very honest.
dialogue: A: Your new haircut makes you look like a mushroom.
B: Don't hold back. Tell us what you really think.
items.note: Fazla açık sözlü birine kuru espri.

items.example: Easy, tiger. It's only a game of table tennis.
items.exampleTr: Sakin ol kaplan. Alt tarafı masa tenisi.
items.simple: Calm down, you are too excited or too keen.
dialogue: A: I'm going to destroy you at this quiz!
B: Easy, tiger.
items.note: Aşırı hevesli ya da agresif birine şakacı uyarı.

items.example: You're here an hour early? Someone's keen.
items.exampleTr: Bir saat erken mi geldin? Birisi baya hevesli.
items.simple: A tease when a person looks too excited about something.
dialogue: A: I've already packed for next month's trip.
B: Someone's keen!
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; aşırı istekliliğe takılmak.

items.example: "I'll pass you the remote." "Careful, you'll strain something."
items.exampleTr: "Kumandayı uzatayım." "Dikkat, bir yerini incitirsin."
items.simple: A joke when someone lazy does a tiny bit of work.
dialogue: A: I'll take one bag, you take the other five.
B: Careful, you'll strain something.
items.note: Tembel birinin küçücük çabasına takılmak.
